scope.outer_blocking: 50-target non-overlapping blocks; final 49-target remainder is retained
scope.historical_independence: RETROSPECTIVE_NESTED_VALIDATION_NOT_UNTOUCHED. Rounds 1244..1249 and the wider historical sample have prior exposure to earlier studies.
scope.prospective_confirmation: Only target 1250 onward is genuinely prospective; one future draw is not sufficient to establish a strict edge.

shared_protocol.training_cutoff_rule: For target t, all model inputs use draws 1..t-1 only. Adaptive selection at target t may use only completed target outcomes strictly before t.

candidate_generator.core6: Top six from the frozen slow score, descending score then lower-number tie-break.
candidate_generator.tail24: Top 24 among the remaining 39 by the frozen equal blend of z-scored slow, medium and fast scores, descending score then lower-number tie-break.

strict_gate.pass_rule: Each metric's Bonferroni-adjusted moving-block bootstrap CI lower bound versus the exact uniform five-disjoint-ticket/union30 null must be strictly greater than zero; additionally, the share of positive non-overlapping 50-target any2 blocks must be at least 0.65.
strict_gate.residual_block: Include the final incomplete block; do not drop it.

nulls.primary: Exact combinatorial uniform null for five disjoint six-number tickets with union size 30, using the frozen V42 exact_null_disjoint30 implementation.
nulls.conditional_allocator_null: 200 random partitions per target of the same 30-number candidate bank; diagnostic only, not a replacement for the primary strict null.

H1250_A.question: With the exact same cutoff-safe candidate top30 held fixed for each target, does allocator geometry change five-line max-hit, any2, any3 and union coverage?
H1250_A.fixed_factor: Candidate bank and H tail order are identical across all four allocators for each target.

adaptive_policy.later_blocks: At each block boundary, choose one geometry using only the immediately preceding 150 completed target rounds.

H1250_A.strict_gate_applies_to: The single predeclared prior-only adaptive geometry policy only.
H1250_A.descriptive_variant_correction: Individual fixed geometries are descriptive only; if their inferential intervals are shown, use Bonferroni alpha 0.05/(4 geometries * 4 metrics) = 0.003125 per interval. They are not eligible for post-hoc champion selection.

H1250_B.question: With allocator geometry fixed, does prior-only dynamic tail24 ranking improve candidate recall and downstream five-line portfolio metrics?
H1250_B.fixed_factor: Slow-model core6 and rr allocator geometry are fixed.

ranker_definitions.G: Frozen rolling300 gap score order within the tail24.
ranker_definitions.C: Frozen rolling300 recent-frequency score order within the tail24.
ranker_definitions.M: Frozen rolling300 momentum score order within the tail24.
ranker_definitions.P: Frozen rolling300 pair-association score order within the tail24.
ranker_definitions.T: Frozen rolling300 triple-association score order within the tail24.

adaptive_policy.later_blocks: At each block boundary, choose one ranker using only the immediately preceding 150 completed target rounds.
adaptive_policy.objective: Highest equal-weight macro-average candidate recall fraction across K=10,15,20,25,30 over the prior 150 completed targets.
adaptive_policy.selection_score: For each of the prior 150 completed targets, compute recall_fraction at K=10,15,20,25,30; take the unweighted mean across the five K values, then average those per-target macro scores across the prior 150 targets.
adaptive_policy.invariance_note: All rankers preserve the same top30 candidate bank membership; recall@30 is invariant and is retained as an audit metric, but cannot be the selector objective by itself.
adaptive_policy.degeneracy_handling: Record the number of prior-only block decisions with tied macro scores. If all decisions tie, retain the registered H,G,C,M,P,T tie-break, report the selector as degenerate, and do not claim dynamic selection.

H1250_B.candidate_recall_random_expectation: Exact uniform K-subset expected winning-number count = 6*K/45.
H1250_B.strict_gate_applies_to: The single predeclared prior-only adaptive ranker policy only.
H1250_B.descriptive_variant_correction: Six rankers by four portfolio metrics use Bonferroni alpha 0.05/(6*4); six rankers by five recall K values use Bonferroni alpha 0.05/(6*5). Individual variants are descriptive only and cannot be promoted after observing outer results.

execution_plan.freeze_date: 2026-11-12 only if an unchanged strict gate passes
execution_plan.weekly_delivery_date: 2026-11-13 only if strict readiness is present
execution_plan.workflow_mode: workflow_dispatch_only; do not add or change schedules

guardrails: No threshold, alpha, block length, comparator, candidate family or metric change after inspecting H1250-A/B outer results.
No use of 1244..1249 as an untouched holdout.
No relabelling RECOVERED_SUCCESSOR_V2 as the missing legacy A/C/contrarian executables.
The studies cannot make DAILY MASTER FULL_COMPLETE while the original legacy executable sources remain unrecovered.
A code or source hash mismatch invalidates the run; it must not be repaired by silently changing the frozen specification.

amendment_reason.finding: The v1 B adaptive selector optimized recall@30, but all six rankers only reorder the same fixed top30 candidate bank. The runner asserts recall@30 invariance, so all rankers tie and the adaptive selector always falls back to H.
amendment_reason.correction: Before any H1250 outer evaluation, change only the prior-only B selector objective to the equal-weight macro-average of candidate recall fractions at K=10,15,20,25,30. This uses the already preregistered K values and lets the tail ordering influence K<30 while retaining K=30 as an invariant audit.
amendment_reason.no_outcomes_read: No H1250-A/B outer evaluation results were read or used to make this correction.
amendment_reason.unchanged: Candidate generator, six rankers, fixed rr allocator, target range, cutoff, warmup, prior-150/50-target block design, random seeds, exact null, matched random design, primary metrics, Bonferroni alpha, bootstrap count, block length, residual-block handling and strict gate are unchanged.

expected_outputs.trace_definition: One row per target, per A allocator or B ranker, per actual winning number; includes fixed candidate-bank stage, ranks, K retention, ticket assignment, and line hit count. Does not contain full recommended ticket combinations.
